headline: XRGPUBinding の故障診断を起動前 row にする
headlineEn: Turning XRGPUBinding faults into pre-launch rows
summary: Meta Browser 152.1 の experimental WebGPU composition layers、WebXR-WebGPU Binding、Immersive Web WebGPU samples、W3C WebXR Layers / Device API を確認し、`XRGPUBinding` 起動前の故障診断 row を作る本命サンプルと、その row から subimage 周辺の復帰策を8 frameで再生する派生サンプルを追加しました。
summaryEn: After checking Meta Browser 152.1 experimental WebGPU composition layers, WebXR-WebGPU Binding, Immersive Web WebGPU samples, and the W3C WebXR Layers / Device APIs, today's original work adds a main sample that turns pre-launch `XRGPUBinding` faults into a triage row and a derivative sample that replays subimage recovery across eight frames.
keyTopics: Meta Browser release notes は 2026-10-02 付近で experimental WebGPU composition layers と WebXR depth projection support を示しており、WebGPU XR の検証対象が単純な対応有無から layer / binding / attachment の運用へ移っています。
WebXR-WebGPU Binding draft は `XRGPUBinding`、`nativeProjectionScaleFactor`、`usesDepthValues`、projection / quad / cylinder / equirect / cube layer 作成、`getSubImage()` を定義しており、起動前診断 row に分解しやすいです。
Binding explainer は `navigator.gpu.requestAdapter({ xrCompatible: true })` と WebGPU-compatible `XRSession` を強調しているため、adapter fault と binding fault を別々に扱う必要があります。
Immersive Web WebGPU samples は barebones VR / AR、input selection、benchmark、hands などを WebGPU XR の最小 smoke test として提供しており、自作サンプルの診断列を考える参考になります。
W3C WebXR Layers API は composition layer と subimage の lifecycle を考える土台になり、projection layer を作れた後も resize、eye、texture lifetime、visibility の復帰設計が必要です。
keyTopicsEn: Meta Browser release notes around 2026-10-02 mention experimental WebGPU composition layers and WebXR depth projection support, moving WebGPU XR validation from simple support checks toward layer, binding, and attachment operations.

The WebXR-WebGPU Binding draft defines `XRGPUBinding`, `nativeProjectionScaleFactor`, `usesDepthValues`, projection / quad / cylinder / equirect / cube layer creation, and `getSubImage()`, which map naturally into pre-launch triage rows.
The binding explainer emphasizes `navigator.gpu.requestAdapter({ xrCompatible: true })` and a WebGPU-compatible `XRSession`, so adapter faults and binding faults should be separated.
Immersive Web WebGPU samples provide minimal smoke tests for barebones VR / AR, input selection, benchmark scenes, and hands, helping shape the diagnostic columns in the original samples.

The W3C WebXR Layers API is the base for composition layer and subimage lifecycle thinking, and recovery still matters after a projection layer exists: resize, eye selection, texture lifetime, and visibility can all fail.

sections.title: 注目事例と何が面白いか
sections.titleEn: Notable example and why it matters
sections.body: Meta Browser release notes の experimental WebGPU composition layers と、WebXR-WebGPU Binding の `XRGPUBinding` / `XRGPUSubImage` は、WebGPU XR を `使えるか` だけでなく `どこで失敗して、何へ復帰するか` として見る段階に入ったことを示しています。今日の自作サンプルでは、起動前の adapter / binding / projection layer の失敗を row 化し、派生サンプルで subimage の resize、stale frame、wrong eye、texture lifetime を短い復帰シナリオにしました。
sections.bodyEn: Meta Browser release notes around experimental WebGPU composition layers and the WebXR-WebGPU Binding's `XRGPUBinding` / `XRGPUSubImage` suggest that WebGPU XR should be treated not just as `supported or not`, but as `where can it fail and what route recovers`. Today's original samples turn adapter / binding / projection layer failures into pre-launch rows, then replay subimage resize, stale frame, wrong eye, and texture lifetime recovery scenarios.

sections.title: 表現・インタラクションのアイデア
sections.body: 本命サンプル `XRGPUBinding Fault Triage Console` は runtime / Meta 152.1 target / adapter fault / binding fault の profile を切り替え、secure context、XR policy、xrCompatible adapter、`XRGPUBinding`、projection layer、optional layers を gate として可視化します。派生サンプル `XRGPUSubImage Fault Recovery Replayer` は、その row を貼り付けて8 frame の subimage fault と復帰策を再生します。
sections.bodyEn: The main sample, `XRGPUBinding Fault Triage Console`, switches among runtime, Meta 152.1 target, adapter fault, and binding fault profiles, visualizing secure context, XR policy, xrCompatible adapter, `XRGPUBinding`, projection layer, and optional layers as gates. The derivative sample, `XRGPUSubImage Fault Recovery Replayer`, accepts that row and replays eight frames of subimage faults and recovery actions.

sections.title: 制作に使えそうな技術メモ
sections.body: 最小 row は `secureContext`、`webgpu`、`xr`、`xrSpatialPolicy`、`xrCompatibleAdapter`、`xrGpuBinding`、`projectionLayer`、`quadLayer`、`nativeScale`、`firstFault`、`route`、`recovery` です。実機では `requestAdapter({ xrCompatible: true })` の成否、`XRGPUBinding(session, device)` の例外名、`createProjectionLayer()` の init、`getSubImage()` の texture / viewport / eye、visibility state を同じ row に足すと、WebGL fallback と scale down の判断に使えます。
sections.bodyEn: The minimal row is `secureContext`, `webgpu`, `xr`, `xrSpatialPolicy`, `xrCompatibleAdapter`, `xrGpuBinding`, `projectionLayer`, `quadLayer`, `nativeScale`, `firstFault`, `route`, and `recovery`. On a device, add the result of `requestAdapter({ xrCompatible: true })`, exception names from `XRGPUBinding(session, device)`, `createProjectionLayer()` init values, `getSubImage()` texture / viewport / eye data, and visibility state into the same row so it can drive WebGL fallback and scale-down decisions.

sections.title: サンプルデータの可能性と組み合わせ
sections.body: 今日の binding triage row は10月12日の composition layer plan、10月11日の depth projection readiness、10月10日の WebGPU probe store、10月8日の frame telemetry schema と接続できます。`firstFault` と `route` を共通列にすると、WebGPU adapter、XR feature negotiation、projection attachment、depth / motion vector / HUD の degrade を同じ daily log として扱えます。
sections.bodyEn: Today's binding triage row connects to the October 12 composition layer plan, October 11 depth projection readiness, October 10 WebGPU probe store, and October 8 frame telemetry schema. Sharing `firstFault` and `route` columns lets WebGPU adapter checks, XR feature negotiation, projection attachments, and depth / motion vector / HUD degradation live in one daily log.

sections.title: 明日以降ウォッチする対象
sections.body: Meta Browser の WebGPU composition layer / depth projection notes、WebXR-WebGPU Binding の issue と `XRGPUSubImage` texture lifetime、Immersive Web WebGPU samples の source 更新、WebXR Layers の projection / quad layer lifecycle、WebXR Device API の session feature descriptor を継続して見ます。自作側では、今日の row を IndexedDB に保存し、実 `getSubImage()` 例外名と viewport size を派生 replayer に読み込ませると発展します。
sections.bodyEn: Keep watching Meta Browser WebGPU composition layer / depth projection notes, WebXR-WebGPU Binding issues and `XRGPUSubImage` texture lifetime, Immersive Web WebGPU sample source updates, WebXR Layers projection / quad layer lifecycle, and WebXR Device API session feature descriptors. On the original side, the next useful step is saving today's row into IndexedDB and loading real `getSubImage()` exception names plus viewport sizes into the derivative replayer.

sections.title: 試すならこれ
sections.body: `XRGPUBinding Fault Triage Console` で profile を `adapter fault` と `binding fault` に切り替え、route が `webgl-projection-fallback` へ落ちる違いを見てください。出力 row を `XRGPUSubImage Fault Recovery Replayer` に貼ると、subimage resize / stale frame / texture lifetime の復帰順を policy 別に確認できます。
sections.bodyEn: In `XRGPUBinding Fault Triage Console`, switch between `adapter fault` and `binding fault` and inspect how the route drops to `webgl-projection-fallback`. Paste the output row into `XRGPUSubImage Fault Recovery Replayer` to compare subimage resize, stale frame, and texture lifetime recovery under different policies.

sections.title: 進行マップ
sections.body: 調査: Meta Browser release notes、WebXR-WebGPU Binding draft / explainer、Immersive Web WebGPU samples、W3C WebXR Layers / Device API を確認。設計: 1本目は XRGPUBinding fault triage、2本目は subimage fault recovery replay。実装: `outputs/2026-10-13_html_xrgpu_binding_fault_triage_console.html` と `outputs/2026-10-13_html_xrgpu_subimage_fault_recovery_replayer.html` を追加。検証: JSON parse、HTML script 構文、日付ページ / index / pages 再生成、publish を行う。
sections.bodyEn: Research: checked Meta Browser release notes, WebXR-WebGPU Binding draft / explainer, Immersive Web WebGPU samples, and W3C WebXR Layers / Device API. Design: make the first sample an XRGPUBinding fault triage console and the second a subimage fault recovery replay. Implementation: add `outputs/2026-10-13_html_xrgpu_binding_fault_triage_console.html` and `outputs/2026-10-13_html_xrgpu_subimage_fault_recovery_replayer.html`. Validation: parse JSON, check embedded scripts, regenerate day / index / pages, and publish.

sections.title: 俯瞰メモ
sections.body: 10月前半の流れは、visibility / prediction / foveation / WebGPU probe / depth projection / composition layer plan から、WebGPU XR の故障境界を小さく分ける段階へ進みました。今日の役割は、`WebGPU composition layers がある` を喜んで終わらせず、adapter、binding、projection layer、subimage の各点で fallback と recovery を持つ形にすることです。
sections.bodyEn: Early October has moved from visibility / prediction / foveation / WebGPU probes / depth projection / composition layer plans toward smaller fault boundaries for WebGPU XR. Today's role is to avoid stopping at `WebGPU composition layers exist` and instead give adapter, binding, projection layer, and subimage stages their own fallback and recovery routes.

sections.title: 今日のミニ試作候補
sections.body: 本命として採用した候補は `XRGPUBinding Fault Triage Console` です。何が動くか: runtime / Meta 152.1 target / adapter fault / binding fault を切り替え、WebGPU XR 起動前の gate、first fault、route、recovery を JSON row として出します。次に足すなら、実 `requestAdapter({ xrCompatible: true })`、`requestSession()`、`XRGPUBinding` constructor、`createProjectionLayer()` の例外名を IndexedDB に保存します。派生として `XRGPUSubImage Fault Recovery Replayer` も実装しました。何が動くか: 1本目の row を貼り付け、8 frame の subimage fault と recovery action を policy 別に再生します。次に足すなら、実 `getSubImage()` / `getViewSubImage()` の viewport、texture lifetime、eye、visibility を読み込んで replay します。
sections.bodyEn: The selected main prototype is `XRGPUBinding Fault Triage Console`. What it does: switches runtime / Meta 152.1 target / adapter fault / binding fault profiles and outputs pre-launch WebGPU XR gates, first fault, route, and recovery as a JSON row. Next addition: save real exception names from `requestAdapter({ xrCompatible: true })`, `requestSession()`, the `XRGPUBinding` constructor, and `createProjectionLayer()` into IndexedDB. The derivative `XRGPUSubImage Fault Recovery Replayer` was also implemented. What it does: accepts the first row and replays eight frames of subimage faults and recovery actions by policy. Next addition: import real `getSubImage()` / `getViewSubImage()` viewport, texture lifetime, eye, and visibility data.
